flags.headline: LRCX -3.38%: largest decliner in the book; no company-specific catalyst found

flags.headline: PGY -1.93%: rate/credit derate flag persists

flags.thesis_link: Matches PGY key_risk: 'Credit cycle deterioration -- rising consumer delinquencies would disproportionately impair Pagaya's portfolio of borrowers rejected by traditional credit models.'

flags.headline: AEM +1.50%: gold-yield pressure flag persists after the 9/29 slide
